title: Algorithm: make a cup of tea
instruction: Put the steps in order so clearly that even a literal robot could do them!
steps: Switch the kettle on and wait until the water boils
Put a tea bag in the mug
Pour boiling water over the tea bag
Take the tea bag out and serve the tea
debrief: In an algorithm the order matters. Each step builds on the one before: you can only pour once the water is boiling, and you take the bag out once the tea has brewed.
why: Without water in the kettle there is nothing to heat.
The water must boil before you pour it.
The bag has to be in the mug before you pour water on it.
Now there is boiling water in the kettle and a bag in the mug.
The tea brews only after you pour the water.
You take the bag out once the tea has brewed.
